tbesh_html:
1) image
1a) images (of tumours, mice, heathen gods)
1b) image, likeness (of resemblance)
1c) mere, empty, image, semblance (fig.)
Aramaic equivalent: tse.lem (צְלֵם "image" H6755)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a phantom, i.e. (figuratively) illusion, resemblance; hence, a representative figure, especially an idol
strongs_1890.derivation: from an unused root meaning to shade;
